description: Source file implementing the socket-based interface for handling execution approvals, decision requests, and command execution on macOS. It includes socket communication, authorization, and user prompting logic.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptServer
classes.description: Singleton class managing the lifecycle of the socket server that handles prompt requests and decisions for execution approvals.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSocketServer
classes.description: Internal class implementing the socket server that listens for incoming connection requests, prompts user decisions, and executes commands.

methods.name: requestDecision
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a decision from the socket at a given path, with a timeout, returning an ExecApprovalDecision.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the socket server to listen for incoming approval requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the socket server and performs cleanup.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Displays a macOS alert dialog to the user asking for approval of the command, returning the user's decision.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles an incoming ExecHostRequest asynchronously, performing validation, prompting, and command execution as needed.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes a shell command with the specified parameters and returns the execution result.
